title: Polyglot SDK 'Bento Box' starter suite: compact examples for Next.js, FastAPI, Go, and CLI with resilient streaming & retries
creator: Asha Menon
description: Provide a compact, opinionated starter suite (the 'Bento Box') of minimal but production-minded examples demonstrating Redwood SDK usage across TypeScript (Next.js), Python (FastAPI), Go (http.Handler), and a cross-platform CLI. Focus: ergonomic streaming patterns, robust retry/backoff strategies (decorrelated jitter, idempotency tokens), resumable streams with checkpointing, and small integration tests. The goal is to give engineers copy-pasteable examples for common app layouts together with guidance on trade-offs (latency vs cost, batching vs immediacy).
acceptance_criteria: A single GitHub repo scaffold (examples/bento-box) with four folders: nextjs/, fastapi/, go-server/, cli/
Each example includes a README with purpose, environment vars, run steps, and a minimal e2e smoke script
Streaming examples show client- and server-side patterns: resume tokens for interrupted streams, incremental rendering (Next.js), and SSE/HTTP chunked patterns (Go/FastAPI)
Retry helpers exported in each language with sensible defaults and ability to inject custom backoffs
CI job that runs smoke tests for each example and publishes a simple benchmark report (latency & token usage) on success
implementation_notes: Next.js: provide two variants: edge-runtime preview component that consumes streaming tokens + server-rendered API route demonstrating incremental SSR and SSE fallback
FastAPI: async endpoints that forward streaming chunks from Redwood SDK to client using StreamingResponse and preserve client disconnect handling
Go: http.Handler example using context cancellation, incremental flush and a small wrapper for re-connecting with a resume token
CLI: subcommand pattern with 'generate' that streams and 'retry' helper demonstrating exponential backoff with jitter and idempotency token usage
Add small reusable code module for metrics hooks (emit token counts, latency per request) with example Prometheus labels
Document recommended environment variable names and a local .env.example for quick start
Instrument each example to use the SDK's streaming API with a short sample prompt and a deterministic seed for smoke tests
notes: Trade-offs considered: full-featured reference app vs tiny examples — chose tiny, composable snippets to reduce maintenance burden
Opted to show both SSE and chunked transfer encodings because different infra (edge vs on-prem) prefers different mechanisms
We intentionally keep retry default low (max 3 attempts) and recommend app-level idempotency for side-effecting calls
Will follow up with a 'cookbook snippets' doc targeted at solutions engineers for copy/paste patterns
